bugs.title: badges.yml does not use packwiz CLI or jq as required by acceptance criterion
bugs.expected: Acceptance criterion states: 'Uses packwiz CLI and jq for JSON manipulation'. The workflow must invoke the packwiz CLI to retrieve mod counts and use jq to construct/write the badge JSON payload.
bugs.suggested_fix: Install packwiz in the workflow (as done in publish.yml), run packwiz list or count via packwiz to get the mod count, then pipe the count through jq to build the badge JSON: e.g. jq -n --arg label "$v" --arg msg "$COUNT mods" '{schemaVersion:1,label:$label,message:$msg,color:"blue"}' > .github/badges/${v}.json
